quotes.thoughts: SalesAssist simplifies and speeds up the sales process and provides tools to get extra engagement from the customer.
quotes.author: Travis Berridge
quotes.position: Internet Sales Director at Murphy Auto Group

quotes.thoughts: SalesAssist definitely advances the time between customers agreeing to the number and doing paperwork... Even if the customer spent 4 hours picking a car, they want to do the paperwork in 10 minutes. SalesAssist makes doing paperwork so much easier and faster!
quotes.author: Jon Ruiz

quotes.thoughts: One of the values of SalesAssist is not losing customer info anymore, e.g. a license print gets lost, or if the finance department asks for something when the customer has already left. Everything is digitalized and imported into the CRM now.
quotes.author: Alex Montanez
quotes.position: VIP Sales Rep at Miracle Toyota
